name: Sunflora
description: The Sun Pokémon. Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

abilities.name: Clorofila
abilities.description: La velocidad de movimiento de este Pokémon se duplica bajo sol abrasador.

abilities.name: Poder Solar
abilities.description: Las tiradas de daño de este Pokémon obtienen +2 bajo sol abrasador.

abilities.name: Madrugar
abilities.description: Este Pokémon tiene ventaja en tiradas para dejar de estar dormido.
